api_schema_changed.title: Hydro-Québec API structure changed
api_schema_changed.description: Hydro-Pannes received an unexpected response from the Hydro-Québec API (missing fields: {missing_fields}). The integration may need to be updated to match a new API structure. If this persists after updating, please report it on the issue tracker.

api_invalid_response.title: Unexpected Hydro-Québec API response
api_invalid_response.description: Hydro-Pannes received a response from the Hydro-Québec API in an unexpected format (a list of locations was expected). Entities stay unavailable until a valid response arrives. If this persists, check whether an integration update is available and report it on the issue tracker.
